in_hebrew.name: אוזברן
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name Osbourne is derived from the Old English name Osbeorn, which means 'bear strength'. The Hebrew name closest in meaning would be 'אוזברן' (Ozvorn), which can be translated as 'strength of the bear'.

in_greek.name: Οσβούρνος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name Osbourne in Greek would be 'Οσβούρνος' (Osbournos), which is derived from the Old English name Osbeorn and translates to 'bear-strong'.

in_latin.name: Osbernus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Osbourne in Latin would be 'Osbernus', which is derived from the Old English name Osbeorn and translates to 'bear-strong'.
